means: Photographic rendering - real skin texture, real optics, continuous tone, no keyline. A camera made this, not a pen.
does: In the POSITIVE prompt on this checkpoint it fights the model entire training and returns the worst of both worlds: waxy semi-real faces, lost line, uncanny proportions. That is why it sits in this project standing NEGATIVE. Put it there and it does real work - it pushes the render back toward clean anime when a photographic noun in the subject line is dragging it off-medium.
reach_for_it: never in the positive on this model. Keep it in the standing negative on every anime render.
used_in: the standing negative documented in craft/ANIME_MODELS.md
